_comment: MCP servers to register on every machine and in every Claude profile.
These live here rather than in settings.json because Claude Code keeps user-scope
MCP config in ~/.claude.json — a file link-profiles.sh refuses to share, since it
also holds oauthAccount and gets rewritten constantly. So each profile needs its
own copy, and apply-mcp-servers.sh merges this file into all of them.
Never put credentials in here: this repo is public. Anything needing a token
belongs in that profile's ~/.claude.json by hand, or in an env var the command
